technical.summary: Mixed bullish technicals on short timeframes (RSI-9, Stoch, Supertrend) are offset by fading momentum, bearish intermediate structure (EMA/SMA 20/50), price below 200-day averages, weak trend strength (ADX 23), and low volume support—high pullback risk.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (265.28) indicates extreme market stress, with earnings 84 days away providing moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term overbought technicals (RSI-9 72.77, Stoch, Supertrend bullish) offer mean-reversion bounce potential if price holds near 46.778 support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Fading intermediate momentum, price below 200-day averages, weak ADX trend strength (23.0), crisis-level VIX, inverted yield curve, zero fundamental conviction, and low volume support create a high-probability pullback environment with unfavorable macro backdrop.
